sections.text: Nine trials have tested or are testing IL-6 receptor inhibitors in NMOSD, including 5 Phase 3, 1 Phase 2, 1 Phase 1, and 2 Phase 4 trials.

Roche leads with 5 trials of satralizumab, and Massachusetts General Hospital, University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center, Fu-Dong Shi, and Tianjin Medical University General Hospital each lead one trial.
Satralizumab and tocilizumab are the main drugs in development, both targeting the IL-6 receptor.
Satralizumab has completed 4 Phase 3 trials and 1 Phase 4 trial in NMOSD.
One Phase 4 trial of satralizumab was terminated due to infeasible recruitment and insufficient eligible patients.
Satralizumab is approved for NMOSD in anti-aquaporin-4 antibody-positive patients.
Recent literature confirms elevated CSF IL-6 in AQP4+ NMOSD and supports IL-6 receptor inhibition as a mechanism to reduce neuroinflammation.
Real-world studies show satralizumab reduces relapse rates and enables corticosteroid reduction in NMOSD patients.
Satralizumab is approved and actively studied in pediatric and comparative effectiveness trials, showing sustained investment.
Tocilizumab is used off-label in NMOSD but lacks a formal NMOSD indication despite clinical use.
Competitors include eculizumab, inebilizumab, and ravulizumab, with real-world data showing treatment switching between them and satralizumab.

read: Mechanism evidence: IL-6 receptor inhibition is validated in NMOSD by approved satralizumab and consistent biomarker and clinical data.
Competitive position: Satralizumab is approved and in active development, but faces competition from other biologics and off-label tocilizumab.
Open questions: Long-term safety, comparative effectiveness, and use in seronegative NMOSD remain under study.
would_change: New evidence of failure in ongoing Phase 3 trials would change this judgement.
Emergence of superior efficacy from competing mechanisms like B-cell depletion could reduce the relative advantage.
Long-term safety signals not captured in current data could shift the risk-benefit balance.
